changelog:
Initial release of Huawei Cloud WAF Query skill.

- Enables querying Huawei Cloud WAF attack events, logs, statistics, and top attack source IPs for security inspection and troubleshooting.
- Read-only: lists and displays, no resource creation or modification.
- Supports attack event search by time, type, action, and domain; event detail retrieval; access/protection logs; attack statistics; threat overviews; and rankings of frequent attack sources.
- Provides command syntax, parameter confirmation, prerequisites, usage workflow, edge-case handling, and reference guides.
- Clarifies CLI quirks, especially usage of domain filtering and array parameters.
summary: Query Huawei Cloud WAF (Web Application Firewall) attack events, access/protection logs, attack statistics, threat overview and top attack source IPs for daily security inspection and incident troubleshooting. Triggers include: "查询WAF攻击事件", "查询WAF告警", "查看WAF防护日志", "查看WAF访问日志", "WAF攻击统计", "WAF威胁概览", "查询攻击源IP", "waf query", "waf attack events", "waf logs", "waf statistics", "web application firewall", "安全日报", "日常巡检WAF".
